title: Persona onboarding 修復頁正確辨識 paper_owner 完整綁定，不再誤報 provisioning 失敗

1_complete_paper_bundle_validation.summary: isCompletePaperBundle in src/management/pages/PersonaOnboarding.tsx and isCompletePaperPersonaBundle / createPersona PaperPersonaBundle validation in src/lib/bff-v1/personas.ts accept paper_running, paper_owner, consultable, and live_owner whenever paper_ledger_id (or paperLedgerId) and runtime_binding_id (or runtimeBindingId) are present and provisioning status is not failed or pending.

2_direct_onboarding_navigation_without_f.summary: Navigating directly to /management/personas/:id/onboarding without a failed_step query parameter and without a backend-reported failed step no longer fabricates 'Reported failed step: provisioning'. Complete bundles (including paper_owner) render the 'Paper Persona provisioning complete' ready state with navigation back to /management/personas/:id; incomplete bundles without a reported failed step render an honest incomplete description without fabricating a failed step.

3_unit_tests.summary: Unit tests in src/management/pages/PersonaOnboarding.test.ts and src/lib/bff-v1/personas.test.ts cover the hosted paper_owner shape of persona-6507750312870d03a241 (澄川｜2317 台股 Paper 學習 R2) with complete paper_ledger_id and runtime_binding_id, all four accepted lifecycle states, genuinely incomplete bundles, failed/pending provisioning status rejections, direct onboarding navigation without failed_step, and explicit failed_step query handling.
